title: Compactification projection respects the pinned whole-system reduction comparison
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $O$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Fix a compactification $c=(j,p_c)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On the small pro-etale sites put $R_W=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(O/\ell^n)_W$ and $B_{n,W}=(O/\ell^n)_W$, for $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers]. Use the derived-complete bounded constructible category $\mathcal C_W=D^b_{ctf}(W,O)$ whose reductions have cohomological and Tor bounds independent of $n$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Put $r_WN=(N\otimes^L_{R_W}B_{n,W})_n$ in the derived category of strict varying-coefficient systems, and $L_W=R\varprojlim\operatorname{Res}$ [det-sp-normalized-equivalence]. Integral pullback and tensor are the completed operations of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]; system pullback $f^*_\bullet$ and system tensor are levelwise finite derived pullback and derived tensor over $B_{\bullet,W}$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-tensor].

Write $P=Rf^c_{!,O}$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], identified with the separately derived composite $Rp_{c,*}j_!$ of [det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower] by its canonical limit comparison (2) and the cofinal restriction $(\ell^n)=(\varpi^{en})$ for a uniformizer $\varpi$ with ramification index $e$; this is the functor $F$ of [lem-sp-integral-reconstruction-comparisons]. Let $F_\bullet=Rf^c_{!,\bullet}$ be the tower compact-support direct image of [det-sp-tower-gluing], and use exactly the natural entire-system comparison
$$b_N:r_YPN\xrightarrow{\sim}F_\bullet r_XN$$
of [lem-sp-integral-reconstruction-comparisons]. This fixes its normalization by the actual compactification direct-image comparison and the reconstruction counit; it is not a choice of isomorphisms of evaluated objects. For $K\in\mathcal C_Y$ and $M\in\mathcal C_X$, put $D_{K,M}=Lf^*K\widehat\otimes^LM$. Let
$$q_{K,M}:r_XD_{K,M}\xrightarrow{\sim}f^*_\bullet r_YK\otimes^Lr_XM,\qquad
\tau_{K,M}:r_Y(K\widehat\otimes^LPM)\xrightarrow{\sim}r_YK\otimes^Lr_YPM$$
be the canonical simultaneous reduction comparisons for completed pullback and tensor. Their normalization uses one flat-term K-flat quotient diagram, tensor balancing and the actual reduction/limit counit, as in [def-pur-integral-derived-operations, det-sp-normalized-equivalence]; their associators, unitors and symmetry are the canonical derived tensor ones. Set $s_{K,M}=(1\otimes b_M)\tau_{K,M}$.

Let $\operatorname{PF}^{c,\mathrm{int}}_{M,K}:PM\widehat\otimes^LK\to P(M\widehat\otimes^LLf^*K)$ and $\operatorname{PF}^{c,\bullet}_{r_XM,r_YK}$ be exactly the compactification projection transformations of [def-exchange-projection], formed from the proper adjunction counit and the unit-normalized open tensor map on these coefficient systems. Let $\alpha_{K,M}:K\widehat\otimes^LPM\to PD_{K,M}$ be the former map with source and target tensor symmetries, and $\alpha^\bullet_{K,M}:r_YK\otimes^LF_\bullet r_XM\to F_\bullet(f^*_\bullet r_YK\otimes^Lr_XM)$ the corresponding system map. Then
$$F_\bullet(q_{K,M})\,b_{D_{K,M}}\,r_Y(\alpha_{K,M})=\alpha^\bullet_{K,M}\,s_{K,M}$$
as an equality in the derived category of entire $B_{\bullet,Y}$-systems, natural in $K,M$ and retaining every quotient transition. All objects displayed belong to the normalized constructible domains. Whenever the two projection maps are invertible, their inverses $\Pi_{K,M}=\alpha_{K,M}^{-1}$ and $\Pi^\bullet_{K,M}=(\alpha^\bullet_{K,M})^{-1}$ therefore satisfy
$$s_{K,M}\,r_Y(\Pi_{K,M})=\Pi^\bullet_{K,M}\,F_\bullet(q_{K,M})\,b_{D_{K,M}}.$$
This assertion uses the specified $b$ throughout and holds for arbitrary ramification of $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$; it is not merely a family of equalities after finite evaluation.

source.place: Clause (2), projection-formula composite in the tensor transpose; agent-extracted compatibility of completed projection with the direct reconstruction comparison, required before integral realization

proof.text: Apply completion_projection_domains for the two exact quotient-unit isomorphisms, all normalized domain assertions, and reconstruction invertibility.
Use ordinary_projection_reduction_square for the ordinary coefficient-first square and its bifunctorial naturality.

Prove reconstruction naturality by assembling openLimit and properLimit as transposes of natural transformations using Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_square. Naturality of the unit, scalar comparisons and counit then gives the reconstruction square. Insert h and v into the ordinary square and cancel r(h.hom) followed by r(h.inv), proving the completed square. q and s are composites of isomorphisms.

Cancel the two invertible projection maps from the completed square and use functoriality to obtain the inverse identity. For naturality, use the two tensor completion-unit naturality squares and ordinary projection naturality, then cancel v and h. This keeps the prescribed h.hom and v.hom, not arbitrary comparison choices.
